Account lthash and bank hash calculation, plus bank lthash updates and account capture writes.

# Purpose
This file implements account and bank hash calculations for the ledger state. The function [`fd_hashes_account_lthash`](<#fd_hashes_account_lthash>) builds an `fd_lthash_value_t` for one account from the account lamports, data, executable flag, owner, and public key. It treats accounts with zero lamports as zero and does not include them in the hash. The function [`fd_hashes_hash_bank`](<#fd_hashes_hash_bank>) then combines the previous bank hash, the signature count, the last blockhash, and the account local transaction hash (`lthash`) to produce the bank hash for a slot with `sha256`.

The file also updates the bank account hash state after an account change. [`fd_hashes_update_lthash`](<#fd_hashes_update_lthash>) computes the new account hash, removes the old account hash from the bank `lthash`, adds the new hash, and ends the locked update on the bank state. If capture is enabled and the account hash changed, it writes the updated account state to the Solana capture file through `fd_solcap_write_account`. This code is part of the bank and account state update path, and it exposes internal hash update logic used by the ledger.
